Name: Account Unlock changed
Description: Changes to the account unlock settings.

Name: Account Upn Name changed
Description: User's principle name was changed.

Name: Active Directory security group created
Description: A new security group was created in Active Directory.

Name: ADCS certificate issued
Description: A certificate was issued using Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS).

Name: ADFS DKM property read
Description: An account read the Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) Distributed Key Manager property.

Name: ADFS settings changed
Description: Modifications made to the Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS) configuration, potentially impacting authentication and access policies.

Name: DES encryption restriction changed
Description: A user account control flag restricting encryption to DES was updated.

Name: Device Account Created
Description: A new device account was created.

Name: Device dNSHostName changed
Description: The DNS hostname of a device was updated.

Name: Device Operating System changed
Description: An operating system attribute was changed.

Name: Directory Service replication
Description: User tried to replicate the directory service.

Name: Domain trusts enumerated
Description: Trust relationships between domains were queried and listed to identify potential lateral movement paths.

Name: Entra Connect password writeback failed
Description: Password writeback attempt using Entra Connect failed.

Name: GMSA password read
Description: The Group Managed Service Account (gMSA) password, which can expose service credentials used for automated tasks and services, was read.

Name: Group Membership changed
Description: User was added/removed, to/from a group, by another user or by themselves.

Name: Group Policy display name changed
Description: The display name of a Group Policy Object was updated.

Name: Group Policy Object created
Description: A new Group Policy Object was created.

Name: Group Policy Object deleted
Description: A Group Policy Object was deleted from Active Directory.

Name: Group Policy settings changed
Description: Settings in a Group Policy Object were updated.

Name: Kerberos preauthentication flag changed
Description: A user account control flag for Kerberos preauthentication was modified.

Name: Plaintext password allow status changed
Description: A user account control flag for plaintext passwords was changed.

Name: Potential lateral movement path identified
Description: Identified potential lateral movement path to a sensitive user.

Name: PowerShell execution
Description: User attempted to remotely execute a PowerShell command.

Name: Private Data Retrieval
Description: User attempted/succeeded to query private data using LSARPC protocol.

Name: SAM account name changed
Description: The Security Account Manager (SAM) account name was modified.

Name: Security Principal created
Description: Account was created (both user and computer).

Name: Security Principal deleted changed
Description: Account was deleted/restored (both user and computer).

Name: Security Principal Display Name changed
Description: Account display name was changed from X to Y.

Name: Security Principal Name changed
Description: Account name attribute was changed.

Name: Security Principal Path changed
Description: Account Distinguished name was changed from X to Y.

Name: Security Principal Sam Name changed
Description: SAM name changed (SAM is the logon name used to support clients and servers running earlier versions of the operating system).

Name: Sensitive DACL changed
Description: A change was made to a sensitive Discretionary Access Control List (DACL).

Name: Service creation
Description: User attempted to remotely create a specific service to a remote machine.

Name: SID-History changed
Description: A modification was made to the account's SID-History attribute.

Name: SMB session
Description: User attempted to enumerate all users with open SMB sessions on the domain controllers.

Name: SmbFileCopy
Description: User copied files using SMB.

Name: Task scheduling
Description: User tried to remotely schedule X task to a remote machine.

Name: User Mail changed
Description: Users email attribute was changed.

Name: User Manager changed
Description: User's manager attribute was changed.

Name: User Phone Number changed
Description: User's phone number attribute was changed.

Name: User Title changed
Description: User's title attribute was changed.

Name: Wmi execution
Description: User attempted to remotely execute a WMI method.

Name: LogonFailed
Description: A user attempted to logon to the device but failed.

Name: LogonSuccess
Description: A user successfully logged on to the device.

Name: DNS query
Description: Type of query user performed against the domain controller (AXFR, TXT, MX, NS, SRV, ANY, DNSKEY)

Name: LDAP query
Description: An LDAP query was performed.

Name: LdapQuery
Description: An LDAP query was performed.

Name: SAMR query
Description: A SAMR query was performed.

Name: Malware ZAP
Description: Zero-hour auto purge (ZAP) took action on an email message found containing malware after delivery.

Name: Manual Remediation
Description: An administrator manually took action on an email message after it was delivered to the user mailbox. This includes actions taken manually through Threat Explorer or approvals of automated investigation and response (AIR) actions.

Name: Phish ZAP
Description: Zero-hour auto purge (ZAP) took action on a phishing email after delivery.

Name: Spam ZAP
Description: Zero-hour auto purge (ZAP) took action on spam email after delivery.

Name: ClickAllowed
Description: The user was allowed to navigate to the URL.

Name: ClickBlocked
Description: The user was blocked from navigating to the URL.

Name: ClickBlockedByTenantPolicy
Description: The user was blocked from navigating to the URL by a tenant policy.

Name: UrlErrorPage
Description: The URL the user clicked showed an error page.

Name: UrlScanInProgress
Description: The URL the user clicked is being scanned by Safe Links.
